summary: 5 reference edits, 30 distinct motions. Every one is mapped to a moment in the Offscript script and rebuilt for v1.1.

motions.name: Word-by-word lead + light serif keyword
motions.how: Small sans words appear as they are spoken; the keyword blurs in as a large upright serif with tracking that tightens. Each block gets its own punch-in with the speaker pushed to the other side.
motions.use: Hook lines 0:00–0:25 and most body lines

motions.name: AI prompt bar typing
motions.how: White rounded search bar with a spark icon slides up under a serif word; the question types in letter by letter.
motions.use: 4:41 “why no one talks about the mortgage industry”

motions.name: Light-leak flash
motions.how: Warm pink leak and over-exposure for ~6 frames across a cut.
motions.use: Into the OFF-SCRIPT title, section changes, end card

motions.name: White serif keyword over the torso
motions.how: Huge white serif word low and centred over the speaker's body, tiny lead words above, tail word below.
motions.use: “destiny”, “passion”, “make it happen”, “lifetime career”

motions.name: Split-screen B-roll slide-in
motions.how: B-roll panel slides in from the right and takes two thirds of the frame while the speaker stays on the left; a red serif word runs across both.
motions.use: 2:07 lawyer / doctor, 4:00 families buying homes

motions.name: Confetti burst on a positive word
motions.how: Small coloured circles, triangles and crosses pop out around the serif word and drift away.
motions.use: 4:04 “paid well”

motions.name: Bold white word stack at chest
motions.how: Small word above, big bold sans word, small tail below, each landing on its spoken word; bottom of frame darkened.
motions.use: 2:43 “Mortgage & loan origination / is not like that”

motions.name: Giant counter behind the head
motions.how: Huge white digits roll up fast and settle, placed behind the speaker so his head covers them; small label appears top-right.
motions.use: 0:32 “$60,000,000” behind the speaker

motions.name: Money counter + chart line
motions.how: Full-screen white-to-lilac gradient; big number counts while a thick line draws across with a glowing dot at its tip; icon cards pop under the line.
motions.use: 3:29 “six figures in less than a month”

motions.name: Pill tags around the speaker
motions.how: White pills with ✕ or ✓ icons pop in at four corners around the speaker, then fade out together.
motions.use: 5:13 not for you if… passive income ✕ shortcut ✕ lazy ✕; 3:05 promote ✓ prospect ✓

motions.name: Icon cards on gradient
motions.how: White cards with bold icons pop in one by one and the row re-centres each time.
motions.use: 4:13 think · generate business · prospect · pipeline · communicate

motions.name: Karaoke caption
motions.how: Lower caption types word by word with the spoken word lit in brand colour; a bigger second line lands with the key phrase highlighted.
motions.use: 4:57 “I hold your hand until you make money”

motions.name: Document + circle face-cam + highlighter
motions.how: Speaker shrinks into a circle over a document; a yellow marker sweeps each line as it is said.
motions.use: 4:35 “how the money moves, how the banks work, the secret…”

motions.name: Shrink-to-card transition
motions.how: The full frame scales down into a rounded card, revealing the next screen behind it.
motions.use: Into the document view and the apply card

motions.name: Giant number fly-in to white card
motions.how: Huge dark number slides across the speaker, then cuts to a clean white screen with the number settled in the centre.
motions.use: 1:10 “retire at 60–65”

motions.name: Cards in a row + number slam
motions.how: Post cards pop in left to right on white; a big coloured number slams over them and the cards fade back.

motions.name: Speaker inside a UI card
motions.how: The talking head shrinks into a rounded ad-style card on white with a pill, copy lines and a button.
motions.use: 5:43 “click below and apply” application card

motions.name: Wavy letter reveal at chest
motions.how: Bold white words build letter by letter with a small vertical wave, tail word smaller.
motions.use: 2:04 “Do not do that.”

motions.name: Two-bar chart
motions.how: Coloured label pills, then gradient bars grow from the bottom and the values pop on top.
motions.use: 1:37 10 years → $100K · 15 years → $200K in debt

motions.name: Glossy icon tiles, camera pan
motions.how: Glass-edged icon tiles pop on foggy navy; the camera pans sideways as each new tile arrives.
motions.use: 1:06 the script: school → degree → graduate → job → retire

motions.name: Spotlight beam
motions.how: A glowing dot throws a light cone that sweeps around to land on an icon.
motions.use: 4:22 “see the opportunity everyone walks past”

motions.name: Tree diagram
motions.how: Top node, then lines draw down and branch to three child nodes that pop in order.
motions.use: 3:56 mortgage industry → help families · impact lives · paid well

motions.name: Title + growing icon row
motions.how: Title blurs in word by word; icons arrive one by one beneath it while the camera eases in.
motions.use: 4:11 “This is the mindset” → what you'll learn

motions.name: Two nodes + dashed connector
motions.how: Left node, a dashed line draws across, right node pops with a caption arrow.
motions.use: 0:48 homeless ---- largest investor deal in South Florida

motions.name: Huge words behind the speaker
motions.how: Giant white words fill the frame behind the speaker (he covers part of them); a coloured second line pops below.
motions.use: 0:26 OFF · SCRIPT behind his head, 4:29 LIFETIME CAREER

motions.name: Caption with brand-colour keyword
motions.how: Small lower caption, the key word lands bigger in the accent colour.
motions.use: Name-free lines like “welcome to OFFSCRIPT”, “I read every application”

motions.name: Ring diagram with pills
motions.how: Title on a blurred frame, a dashed ring draws around it and pills pop on the ring.
motions.use: 5:38 serious about: the mindset · the work · making money

motions.name: Numbered chips beside the speaker
motions.how: Square chips 01, 02, 03 pop in a row next to the speaker with a caption underneath.
motions.use: 1:58 easier · faster · more flexible

motions.name: Count-up beside the speaker
motions.how: Big accent number counts up (0 → 15 YEARS) next to the speaker with a small sub-line.
motions.use: 2:27 “even if you practice for 10 years”

motions.name: Icon list on blurred background
motions.how: The frame blurs heavily; a heading and an icon list build line by line.
motions.use: 5:02 shops · retail · brokers · banks · lenders
